quelle: AI, Consciousness and the Future of Humanity | Mustafa Suleyman & Yuval Noah Harari (Kanal Yuval Noah Harari, 18.11.2026)
wortlaut: I need a much deeper understanding of the human mind, of consciousness, and we are not developing it at the right pace. ... for every $10 we spend on developing artificial intelligence we could invest at least $1 in developing our consciousness, I think we'll be okay. But this is not the current trajectory we are on, and we don't have a lot of time, we're running out of time.
